states.title: My Jobs loading
states.trigger: Open My Jobs without usable cached data.
states.expected: Show the My Jobs heading, filter skeleton, and three noninteractive card skeletons; mark the main region aria-busy. Do not flash an empty state or mutate data.
states.action: Wait for the hired-jobs list read.

states.title: My Jobs with hired jobs
states.trigger: The authorized list read returns one or more hired jobs.
states.expected: Show only owned jobs with Job #ID, survey names, creator, agreed price, deadline, lifecycle badge, and View job. Sort Job ID descending, 20 per page; do not show inline Start.
states.action: View job, change the status filter, or change page.

states.title: No active jobs
states.trigger: The Active jobs filter returns no jobs.
states.expected: Show “No active jobs” and “Jobs appear here after a creator accepts your offer.” View all my jobs switches to All; also show Back to overview.
states.action: View all my jobs or Back to overview.

states.title: No hired jobs
states.trigger: The All my jobs filter returns no jobs.
states.expected: Show “No hired jobs yet” and “Jobs appear here after a creator accepts your offer.” Do not route to the unavailable Invitations page as a successful next step.

states.title: No jobs for this status
states.trigger: A selected status filter returns no jobs.
states.expected: Show “No jobs with this status” and retain the selected filter.
states.action: Clear filter to return to Active jobs.

states.title: My Jobs load error
states.trigger: Initial list request fails.
states.expected: Show “Jobs couldn’t load. Try again.” Do not show fake records or empty-state language.

states.title: Previously loaded jobs
states.trigger: A list refresh, filter, or page request fails after results have loaded.
states.expected: Show a warning that latest results could not load and mark retained cards “Previously loaded results.” Keep controls usable; opening a job always revalidates it.
states.action: Retry the list read or open a job to revalidate.

states.title: Changing list filter or page
states.trigger: Change status filter or page in My Jobs.
states.expected: Keep the filter accessible while results load; preserve filter/page in the URL, reset page to 1 on filter change, announce result count, and ignore late responses from prior filters.

states.title: My Jobs unavailable
states.trigger: The hired-jobs feature is unavailable.
states.expected: Show “My Jobs isn’t available yet. Please return to your overview.” Do not loop loading or substitute demo fixtures.

states.title: Job details loading
states.trigger: Open a job link or refresh job details while a read is pending.
states.expected: Keep the detail layout with skeleton content and no Start action; mark loading accessibly. Do not expose unverified job data.

states.title: Accepted job ready to start
states.trigger: Authoritative read confirms an owned Accepted job with its valid selected Accepted offer.
states.expected: Show the Contract heading, Accepted badge, agreed price, verified survey context and an enabled Start job action. Omit repeated explanations of the visible status.

states.title: Job details load error
states.trigger: Initial job detail network or server read fails.
states.expected: Show “Job details couldn’t load” with “Try again.” Show no old job title, context, or enabled Start.
states.action: Try again or Back to My Jobs.

states.title: Job in progress
states.trigger: The hired-job read confirms In Progress.
states.expected: Show the Contract heading, In Progress badge and agreed price. Keep the page read-only with Refresh job and the consistent top-left return link; omit repeated status descriptions.
states.action: Refresh job or Back to My Jobs.

states.title: Completed or cancelled job
states.trigger: The hired-job read confirms Completed or Cancelled.
states.expected: Show the matching textual badge and read-only context. Add no Start, review, payment, or cancellation action.

states.title: Job unavailable
states.trigger: The authorized read cannot verify a job available to this marketer.
states.expected: Show “Job unavailable” and “This job couldn’t be found or you don’t have access to it.” Do not show job title, creator, offer, price, or other identifying context.

states.title: Marketer access required
states.trigger: No active marketer membership is found.
states.expected: Show “Marketer access required” and “Use an account with marketer access to view hired jobs.” Show no job data; role switching is not permission elevation.

states.title: Job details need refreshing
states.trigger: Required job data or start capability cannot be verified.
states.expected: Show “Job details need refreshing” and “This job isn’t ready to start. Refresh its details or contact support.” Hide untrusted fields; do not mutate or display false status such as Cancelled.

states.title: Accepted job with optional context missing
states.trigger: Authoritative read confirms an eligible Accepted job with one or more optional fields absent.
states.expected: Keep the normal Accepted detail and enabled Start action. Use “No brief attached,” “No deadline set,” “Target not specified,” “Link unavailable,” or “Not specified” for absent optional values; do not invent a deadline or block start.

states.title: Session expired
states.trigger: Initial detail read returns unauthenticated.
states.expected: Send the viewer to sign-in with a same-origin allowlisted return URL. Show “Your session expired. Sign in to check this job’s status.” Re-read after login; never auto-start or auto-replay.

states.title: Confirm start
states.trigger: Select Start job on D02 or D09.
states.expected: Use the declarative Start job title, Job #ID and the server-provided agreed THB price. Initially focus Cancel, or the visible heading if the dialog scrolls; preserve a focus trap and a close control. Do not repeat the obvious status transition.

states.title: Confirmation dismissed
states.trigger: Select Cancel or close icon, press Escape, press outside, or use browser Back before confirmation.
states.expected: Return to the Accepted detail and originating scroll position; restore focus to Start job when the page remains. Send zero start requests. Browser Back follows normal history and sends no mutation.
states.action: Start job again or continue normal navigation.

states.title: Start request submitting
states.trigger: Confirm with click, Enter, or Space on the focused Start job button.
states.expected: Show one busy submission with concise progress. Prevent duplicate submission while keeping Close, Escape, outside dismissal and Continue browsing available. Dismissal preserves the operation and a View progress affordance.
states.action: Continue browsing, reopen progress, or await the result.

states.title: Start request taking longer
states.trigger: The same request is still pending after six seconds.
states.expected: Keep the same concise progress presentation and enabled dismissal. A 12-second presentation deadline becomes an unknown outcome with read recovery; it never asserts rollback or sends another POST.
states.action: Continue browsing, reopen progress, or check after an unknown result.

states.title: Pending confirmation dismissed
states.trigger: Press Escape or outside the dialog while a request is pending.
states.expected: Close the confirmation, keep the original operation active and expose View progress. Do not duplicate the write or claim cancellation. On return after document navigation, retain unknown/check state without replaying intent.

states.title: Safe return after navigation
states.trigger: Navigate, reload, or close the tab during submission.
states.expected: Allow normal browser navigation without a beforeunload trap or undo promise. On return, make a fresh authoritative read through the safe internal return path; never auto-repeat POST or expose cached private details before authorization.
states.action: Navigate normally; re-read the job on return.

states.title: Job started
states.trigger: A valid start response confirms outcome=started and In Progress.
states.expected: Close the dialog, show the In Progress badge and “Job started” / “Status changed to In Progress.” Announce once, focus the detail heading, invalidate list/detail caches, and retain the confirmed result if a background read fails.
states.action: Refresh job or Back to My Jobs.

states.title: Start rejected; recheck required
states.trigger: A retryable business rejection explicitly confirms no mutation.
states.expected: Close the dialog and show a persistent error alert with the latest details. Keep Start disabled until an authoritative read confirms retry eligibility; do not automatically POST. The approved docs specify no exact body copy for this rejection.

states.title: Checking job status
states.trigger: Start request times out, connection is lost after submit, server returns 5xx, or success body is malformed.
states.expected: Close the dialog, show “Checking job status…,” and disable Start while issuing a fresh detail GET. A transport failure does not prove rollback.
states.action: Wait for the authoritative status read.

states.title: Already in progress
states.trigger: Fresh detail GET after an uncertain start shows owned In Progress.
states.expected: Show In Progress and “This job is already in progress.” Do not send a second POST or claim this tab caused the transition.
states.action: Refresh job or Back to My Jobs.

states.title: Accepted after outcome check
states.trigger: Reconciliation GET confirms valid owned Accepted after an ambiguous request.
states.expected: Show “The latest check shows Accepted. You can try again.” Enable a fresh confirmation only under the atomic idempotent contract: an earlier request may still commit, so the GET alone does not make retry safe.
states.action: Start job to open a new confirmation.

states.title: Start status not confirmed
states.trigger: The detail GET following an uncertain start fails.
states.expected: Show “Start status not confirmed” and “We couldn’t confirm whether this job started. Refresh to check its current status.” Retain details only as last confirmed; do not label Accepted as current or enable Start.

states.title: Repeated start already in progress
states.trigger: The server returns 200 and outcome=already_in_progress for an authorized repeated start.
states.expected: Show the In Progress badge and informational “This job is already in progress.” Treat repeat start as success, not a 409; do not claim which session started it.
states.action: Refresh job or Back to My Jobs.

states.title: Job is terminal
states.trigger: Start returns job_not_startable and re-read confirms Completed or Cancelled.
states.expected: Show the authoritative terminal badge and “This job is now {status} and can’t be started.” Remove Start; add no terminal action.

states.title: Start permission denied
states.trigger: Start returns 403 and a separate authorized read confirms the viewer may still see this job.
states.expected: Show “Unable to start job” and “You don’t have permission to start this job.” Remove Start and refresh details/capability; retain context only while read permission remains valid.

states.title: Access no longer available
states.trigger: Start or refreshed read returns not found or inaccessible.
states.expected: Show the same generic “Job unavailable” page as a missing job, clear cached job details, and reveal no owner, offer, title, or price.

states.title: Session expired during start check
states.trigger: Start or re-read returns 401.
states.expected: Clear private job details and show “Your session expired. Sign in to check this job’s status.” Use a safe return URL; re-read after sign-in and never auto-resubmit.

states.title: Required start details invalid
states.trigger: The accepted job has no valid selected Accepted offer for this job.
states.expected: Show “This job isn’t ready to start. Refresh its details or contact support.” Do not show an offer selector or raw database/trigger errors; do not enable Start.

states.title: Offline before start
states.trigger: The browser knows it is offline before Start is submitted.
states.expected: Retain the pink Start job affordance. Activation explains the connection requirement and sends no write; it does not silently queue a request. Accepted remains the last confirmed status until refreshed.
states.action: Read the connection feedback, then reconnect and refresh.

states.title: Rejected start; latest status unavailable
states.trigger: A known start rejection is followed by a failed refresh.
states.expected: Show the start-status error and “Latest status unavailable.” Keep Start disabled until an authoritative refresh succeeds and no earlier start remains unresolved.

states.title: Rechecking after returning to the page
states.trigger: This page regains focus after another tab may have started the job.
states.expected: Run one background authoritative refresh, show “Checking job status…,” and disable Start while checking. Preserve focus; use no polling loop or realtime promise.

states.title: Latest details could not refresh after start
states.trigger: After a confirmed start, the background refresh fails.
states.expected: Keep In Progress labeled as last confirmed and show “Couldn’t load the latest details. Showing the last confirmed information.” Offer Refresh job; never revert to Accepted or claim the start failed.
states.action: Refresh job or Back to My Jobs.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 27; Sprint Backlog III rows 31–33, 35 and 38
criteria.requirement: For an In Progress job, the marketer can submit a delivery URL as a Proof attachment and see the saved URL and upload timestamp.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 27; Sprint Backlog III rows 30, 34 and 36
criteria.requirement: An attachment type outside Brief, Proof and Other is rejected. This form always submits Proof and does not offer binary file upload.
Proof submission is available only while the job is In Progress.

states.title: Start with no proof
states.trigger: The In Progress job and its saved-proof list have loaded successfully, with no rows.
states.expected: Show one compact saved-proof workspace with an empty state and Add proof action. Opening Add proof reveals an inline Delivery link form in the same workspace.
states.action: Open Add proof and enter a delivery link.

states.title: Paste a delivery link
states.trigger: The marketer enters a candidate delivery URL.
states.expected: Show the Delivery link field above the saved list in one workspace. Keep the attachment type fixed internally to Proof. URL shape alone does not verify remote sharing permissions.

states.title: Save once
states.trigger: A valid URL is submitted.
states.expected: Submit once and retain the draft until confirmation. Continue browsing closes the form while saving continues; View progress reopens it. A 12-second deadline or document return restores explicit uncertainty and check-before-retry.

states.title: Proof is saved
states.trigger: The save receives a confirmed success response.
states.expected: Show one saved Proof URL and its server-generated timestamp. Clear the draft only after confirmation.
states.action: Add another proof or review the saved evidence.

states.title: Add another link
states.trigger: The marketer starts a second proof while existing evidence is present.
states.expected: Keep existing evidence visible below the inline form in the same saved-proof workspace.

states.title: Review delivery evidence
states.trigger: The saved-proof list contains multiple records.
states.expected: Show full clickable URLs and timestamps newest first. Saving proof does not complete the job.
states.action: Review a link or add another proof while the job is In Progress.

states.title: Correct the URL
states.trigger: The marketer submits an empty or malformed URL.
states.expected: Keep the draft, show an inline field error, focus the input, and create no saved row.

states.title: Attachment type rejected
states.trigger: The simulated server rejects the Proof attachment type.
states.expected: Show an explicit rejection, create no visible row, and retain the URL for recovery.

states.title: Connection lost during save
states.trigger: The save response is interrupted and its outcome is unknown.
states.expected: Do not optimistically show a saved row or submit again. Read the authoritative list before deciding whether a retry is safe.

states.title: Checked: link was not saved
states.trigger: A successful reconciliation read confirms the new link is absent.
states.expected: Keep the URL and make one explicit retry available. Never replay the original request automatically.
states.action: Choose Save proof to make a new explicit attempt.

states.title: Saved proof cannot load
states.trigger: The initial list read fails.
states.expected: Show a consistent top-left return, page header and one recovery group. Do not present failed loading as an empty list or enable submission without known context.

states.title: Job status has changed
states.trigger: A fresh response says the job is no longer In Progress.
states.expected: Remove the submit action and refresh the job context before showing its current status.

states.title: Access is no longer available
states.trigger: The server denies access to the job.
states.expected: Clear private job details, proof URLs, and the unsaved draft from the screen.

states.title: Loading saved proof
states.trigger: The initial job and saved-proof read is pending.
states.expected: Show neutral progress and Stop waiting, plus navigation. After 12 seconds expose read recovery. Do not imply an empty list or enable submit while context is unknown.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 28; US-031 row 32; Sprint Backlog III row 39
criteria.requirement: Block completion without at least one Proof attachment; Brief and Other do not qualify.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 28; US-031 row 32; Sprint Backlog III row 39
criteria.requirement: Complete only an In Progress job with a valid selected Accepted offer, Paid payment and Proof.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 28; US-031 row 32; Sprint Backlog III row 39
criteria.requirement: Keep status unchanged on rejection and reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying.

states.title: Missing proof
states.trigger: Open an In Progress job with no Proof attachments.
states.expected: Show missing Proof and keep the job In Progress. Run completion check opens the blocked warning.

states.title: Completion blocked warning
states.trigger: Attempt completion with no Proof.
states.expected: Use a compact Requirements incomplete dialog, short blocker list and clear proof route. Keep status unchanged; avoid repeated paragraphs and competing recovery buttons.

states.title: All requirements met
states.trigger: A Proof record, Paid payment and correct Accepted offer exist.
states.expected: Enable an explicit completion check; proof alone is not sufficient.

states.title: Confirm completion
states.trigger: Run completion check when all conditions are met.
states.expected: Confirm job identity and the final transition before sending a request.

states.title: Completion pending
states.trigger: Confirm completion.
states.expected: Submit once. Permit Close, Escape, outside dismissal and Continue browsing while preserving the operation and View progress. A 12-second deadline or document return becomes unknown/check state with no automatic resubmission.

states.title: Completion confirmed
states.trigger: Receive a confirmed completion response.
states.expected: Show Completed and remove the completion mutation.

states.title: Payment is not Paid
states.trigger: Proof exists but payment is unpaid.
states.expected: Show the missing payment prerequisite and block completion.

states.title: Accepted offer mismatch
states.trigger: The selected offer is not a valid Accepted offer for this job.
states.expected: Explain the offer prerequisite and keep status unchanged.

states.title: Job has not started
states.trigger: The job is Accepted.
states.expected: Do not expose a completion request for an unstarted job.

states.title: Cancelled job
states.trigger: Read a Cancelled job.
states.expected: Keep the terminal state read-only.

states.title: Unknown completion outcome
states.trigger: The completion response is lost.
states.expected: Offer a read-only status check; never automatically repeat completion.

states.title: Requirements unavailable
states.trigger: A job read fails.
states.expected: Show read failure rather than known prerequisites and disable completion.

states.title: Access removed
states.trigger: Access is denied.
states.expected: Remove all private job and delivery data.

states.title: Requirements loading
states.trigger: The initial requirements read is pending.
states.expected: Announce the read and prevent completion until resolved.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Allow the owning creator to cancel Pending, Accepted or In Progress jobs only when no payment is Paid.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Confirmed cancellation sets Cancelled, closes active job requests and rejects remaining Pending offers.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Reject cancellation for Completed or Paid jobs, keep terminal states read-only and recover unknown outcomes with a read.

states.title: Pending job
states.trigger: Open a Pending unpaid job.
states.expected: Cancellation is available to the creator.

states.title: Accepted job
states.trigger: Open an Accepted unpaid job.
states.expected: Show current contract details and an explicit cancel action.

states.title: In Progress job
states.trigger: Open an In Progress unpaid job.
states.expected: Allow cancellation with its consequences explained.

states.title: Cancellation confirmation
states.trigger: Choose Cancel job.
states.expected: Show job identity and effects; Keep job closes the dialog without changes.

states.title: Cancellation pending
states.trigger: Confirm cancellation.
states.expected: Submit once. Permit Close, Escape, outside dismissal and Continue browsing while preserving the operation and View progress. A 12-second deadline or document return becomes unknown/check state with no automatic resubmission.

states.title: Cancellation confirmed
states.trigger: Receive confirmed cancellation.
states.expected: Show Cancelled, zero active requests and zero Pending offers; remove cancellation.

states.title: Paid job
states.trigger: A payment is already Paid.
states.expected: Explain why cancellation is unavailable and do not enable cancellation.

states.title: Completed job
states.trigger: Read a Completed job.
states.expected: Preserve payment and review history; do not allow cancellation.

states.title: Already Cancelled
states.trigger: Read a Cancelled job.
states.expected: Keep cancellation read-only and do not resubmit.

states.title: Unverified state
states.trigger: The current state is not recognized.
states.expected: Do not guess eligibility; offer a fresh read.

states.title: Unknown cancellation outcome
states.trigger: Lose the cancellation response.
states.expected: Check current job state before a new cancellation.

states.title: Cancellation rejected
states.trigger: Receive a rejection without a state change.
states.expected: Keep the current contract and offer refresh.

states.title: Access removed
states.trigger: Lose access to the job.
states.expected: Remove private contract data and mutation controls.

states.title: Job read failed
states.trigger: Cannot read job eligibility.
states.expected: Show failure rather than an empty or cancellable job.

states.title: Job loading
states.trigger: Read the current job.
states.expected: Prevent cancellation while eligibility is unknown.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 35; Sprint Backlog III rows 98–100
criteria.requirement: Show only reviews on Completed jobs where this marketer held the accepted offer.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 35; Sprint Backlog III rows 98–100
criteria.requirement: Display a 1–5 rating, optional comment, created_at and linked job_id.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 35; Sprint Backlog III rows 98–100
criteria.requirement: When no qualifying reviews exist, show No reviews yet / No ratings yet and no numeric zero average.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 35; Sprint Backlog III rows 98–100
criteria.requirement: Keep loading and read errors distinct; support long comments, rating filters and pagination.

states.title: Verified reviews
states.trigger: Open a marketer profile with qualifying reviews.
states.expected: Show average, count and verified cards from completed jobs.

states.title: No reviews yet
states.trigger: There are no qualifying reviews.
states.expected: Show No reviews yet and No ratings yet without a 0.00 average.

states.title: Rating-only reviews
states.trigger: Reviews have no written comments.
states.expected: Show rating, date and linked job without inventing a comment.

states.title: Long written review
states.trigger: A review contains long Unicode text.
states.expected: Show a bounded preview with native Read full review / Show less disclosure. Preserve the complete Unicode comment, author, date and rating; expansion survives appearance re-renders.

states.title: Next review page
states.trigger: Open a longer review history.
states.expected: Show bounded pagination and retain rating filter.

states.title: Nonqualifying records excluded
states.trigger: Fixture includes uncompleted, wrong-marketer and invalid-rating records.
states.expected: Exclude them from cards, count, average and distribution.

states.title: No matching rating
states.trigger: Filter to 1 star when no 1-star reviews exist.
states.expected: Keep the true overall rating, show a compact filter-specific empty state and Show all ratings reset. Omit redundant single-page pagination.

states.title: Reviews loading
states.trigger: Review read is pending.
states.expected: Do not invent a zero rating or empty review conclusion.

states.title: Reviews read failed
states.trigger: Cannot read verified records.
states.expected: Show retry and suppress the unavailable rating.

states.title: Profile unavailable
states.trigger: Profile access is denied.
states.expected: Show a generic unavailable state without review details.
